chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from 'Ali ibn Ri'ab, from Zurarah, who said:
I said to Abī Ja‘far عليه السلام: “Is there a known limit between al-zuhr and al-'asr?” He said: “No.”

key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ: Abī Ja‘far, the Imam addressed in the narration
key_terms.لَا: a negation meaning there is no such fixed boundary

ai.seo_question: Is there a fixed known boundary between the times of al-zuhr and al-'asr according to Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith indicates that there is no fixed known boundary separating the time of al-zuhr and al-'asr in the manner asked by the questioner. It relates to the legal understanding of prayer times and the performance of the obligatory salat.
